scope: New JSON files only. No preexisting file is edited, renamed, removed, or relocated.

current_aws_interfaces.style: Existing style and service worker unchanged

loading_plan: Application integration is a separate task. When requested, load manifest.json from AWS/json/azaraan-rules/ and keep semantic phonemes, glyph mapping and historical lexicon as distinct stores.
expected_engine_pipeline: Load manifest + alphabet + registry + era grammar
Validate era-specific orthography and host/subscript counts
Resolve lexical historical exceptions before generic sound changes
Resolve base family, accent semantics and dependent vowels
Apply era-specific morphology, word order and phonotactics
Render with actual user-provided Aza'raan fonts once glyph-to-Unicode mapping exists
source_fidelity: The canonical DOCX header supersedes contradictory older rules except where the user's current instructions explicitly supersede it
The 20 modern letters apply from Classical onward; do not retroactively erase Proto, Ancient or Archaic characters
All older source IPA variants persist as sound slots or contextual realizations
Aza'raan origin remains Kaʻaheʻanua plus Uxrowoiye
Do not silently import entire Māori verb system or Khmer inherent-vowel values
Keep unassigned Khmer Unicode entries unassigned
pending_authorial_decisions: Exact unique native glyph for each semantic accent
Final Khmer Unicode mapping for each modern glyph
Full lexicon of the 15 identity categories
Review provisional Aza'raan particle words for collisions
Preferred precedence of sound stress versus decorative accents
format: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation, no em dashes
